svg.text: A5 bid programme - Gantt - ADD-03 - planning date 2026-11-05 (PROPOSAL, not reviewed)

Earliest dates: forward pass from 2026-11-05 (first Working Day on or after the planning date, the ADD-03 issue date). Latest dates: backward pass from the pack deadlines. Working Days Sun-Thu (VOL-I 2.4). Every duration, effort, waiting party and capacity is a PROVISIONAL ASSUMPTION (config/assumptions.yaml).
